installed_driver: link A selection only, before the full-reset fallback

preconditions: Argus stopped; sensor and bridge drivers unloaded
Working bridges parked on link A with CTRL0=0x21
Readback CTRL0=0x01 and chip ID=0x94 three times
software_reset_marker.local_recovery: Host bus clear, then two bounded CTRL0=0x01 attempts, each with 20 ms wait and identity verification
software_reset_marker.interpretation: Marker clearing verifies a register-reset effect. The lane-count default discrepancy remains unresolved; no claim that every internal domain was verified.
software_reset_marker.script_verdict_note: The original script logged full_reset_verified=false because it additionally required both lane-count registers to read 0xc0.
software_reset_marker.comparison_limit: Earlier 0x80 trials lacked this marker; superiority of 0x81 over 0x80 is not established.

gpio_tests.individual_sequence: Output latch 0 -> 1, wait 200 ms, sample bridges, restore 0, wait 300 ms, sample again
gpio_tests.shared_enable: PCC.00 low 3 seconds, high 3 seconds, host bus clear, read bridges before driver reload
gpio_tests.scope: Output latches verified; no chip-pin voltage, PWDNB continuity or supply measurement.

remote_isolation_experiment.result: Acknowledged write, failed readback, local access lost. Planned marker write and RESET_ALL were not reached.
recovery: Twelve bounded rounds at 100 kHz: host bus clear, REG1=0x02, 100 ms wait, CTRL0=0x01, 20 ms wait, identity reads
Final round returned chip ID 0x94 three times but REG1=0x03
At restored 400 kHz, repeated reads confirmed REG1=0x03
One further REG1=0x02 write, readback 0x02 twice and chip ID 0x94
CTRL0=0x21, wait 300 ms, verify REG1=0x02, CTRL0=0x01, chip ID 0x94
Bind bridge driver; both sensors bound
remote_isolation_experiment.cause_limit: The write that produced REG1=0x03 is not identified; intervening failed writes may have taken effect.
remote_isolation_experiment.recommendation: Do not use the DIS_REM_CC experiment as a validated recovery procedure on this box.

open_questions: Actual MAX9296A PWDNB/supply wiring on this carrier
Cause of persistent pair-2 control-access failure
Published versus observed lane-count reset defaults
Mux readback of 0xff despite verified branch separation between buses 30 and 31
